messages:
Rina: Heads-up I opened a docs PR for private installer notes around firewalld and KMS certs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/507
Theo: Nice. Can we add a short firewalld example? Some customers run firewalld enabled by default and pods can't reach 6000/tcp.
Marco (infra): Example I use in guides: `sudo firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=443/tcp` and `--add-port=6000/tcp`, then `sudo firewall-cmd --reload`. Also mention `--add-rich-rule` for zone binding.
Rina: Adding that. Also, the PR needs a clear note about hostNetwork vs pod network when using podman; users ran into port conflicts.
Theo: Good call. For podman, note `--network host` vs podman bridge; add link to podman docs.
Priya (security): Two security notes: 1) Explicitly say KMS proxy requires client certs when HSM is enabled. 2) Recommend rotating client certs via our rotation script and include path `/etc/redwood/certs`.
Rina: I'll add the cert rotation snippet and a short troubleshooting tip: "If 403 from KMS, check cert CN and system time."
Marco (infra): Also mention SELinux boolean for container runtimes when using hostNetwork on RHEL variants: `setsebool -P container_manage_cgroup true` (or whatever we documented).
Theo: Small nit: the image import section should show both ctr and podman commands. I'll paste them in a follow-up commit.
docs-bot: Automated check: link sanity scan passed for modified files, except external podman link flagged as external (ok).
Rina: Thanks — updated PR with firewalld example, cert rotation, and hostNetwork note. Merging after one more security ack.
Priya (security): Ack from sec side, looks good.
Rina: Merged. Thanks everyone!
